title: Dru Knox on the Loops Your Software Factory Needs
description:
Join us in November for AI DevCon NYC 2026. Buy your ticket now, with 30% off using code DRU30:
https://tessl.co/zs6

Loop engineering is the groundwork that decides whether your software factory scales as agents get more capable. Dru Knox, Tessl's head of product and design, previews his AI DevCon NYC talk on the most important loops to set up early in your factory journey.

What we cover:
– The agent feedback loops to establish early in your software factory journey
– Why loop engineering sets you up to scale as coding agents become more capable
– How to set these loops up in your own environment
– What to expect from Dru's talk at AI DevCon NYC this November

Build your software factory, one workflow at a time, with Tessl:
